lock.intro:
Your ID stays on this phone.
Confirm it's you to open the app.
lock.passcodeNote: No biometrics are set up on this device, so the app opens with your device passcode.
lock.rule: You'll confirm it's you every time you open the app, and whenever you come back after more than a minute in another app.
lock.proofPrompt: Confirm it's you before creating a proof
lock.wipeBody: The IDs saved on this phone can no longer be read. Erase them, then bring your ID in again from the mobile ID app. Your proof history is kept.

home.emptyBody: Bring in your ID from the mobile ID app once, and every proof after that is created right here on this phone.
home.removeBody: Only the copy saved on this phone is removed. Your ID in the mobile ID app stays as it is, and you can bring it in again whenever you need it. Your proof history is kept.

factDesc.mdl_kr_ownership: That you hold a valid mobile ID
factDesc.mdl_kr_age: That you meet the service's minimum age (by birth year). Your date of birth is not shared
factDesc.mdl_kr_region: That you live in a given province or city. Your address is not shared

proofs.title: Proofs
proofs.intro: You answer only the one question a service asks. Nothing on your ID is shared.
proofs.howTo: Tap a "Prove with KProof" button or link on a service, or scan its QR code with the scan button in the middle, and the request comes to this app.
proofs.pickNote: Choose which ID to prove with. When a request arrives, this choice is selected for you.
proofs.inAppNote: "Try it in the app" creates a real request, just like the demo site, proves it in this app, and then shows the proof being verified on chain.

question.mdl_kr_ownership:
wants to confirm that you
hold a valid mobile ID
question.mdl_kr_age:
wants to confirm that you
are {{age}} or older
question.mdl_kr_region:
wants to confirm that you
live in {{region}}

request.ageBasis: Age is counted by birth year (this year − birth year).

sendsFact.mdl_kr_ownership: One fact: you hold a valid mobile ID
sendsFact.mdl_kr_age: One fact: you are {{age}} or older

request.sendsNullifier: A duplicate-check value used only by this service
request.sendsNullifierNote: Comparing it with other services can't tell them it's the same person
request.noCardBody: Add an ID first. Otherwise this request is answered with a decline.

cannot.ageBelow: By the birth year on this ID, you are not {{age}} or older.
cannot.noAddress: This ID has no address, so it can't prove where you live.
cannot.regionDiffers: The address on this ID is not in {{region}}.

proving.title: Creating your proof
proving.body:
Everything is computed on this phone.
Your ID never leaves it.

steps.verify: Checking the proof on this phone (off-chain)

addId.title:
Bring your mobile ID
into KProof
addId.intro: KProof receives your ID details once from the mobile ID app and keeps them encrypted on this phone only.
addId.pick: Choose the ID to bring in
addId.representative: The mobile ID app sends whichever ID is set as your primary ID. Set the ID you choose here as primary in that app, then bring it in.
addId.mismatch: You chose the {{chose}}, but the mobile ID app sent the {{received}}. Make the {{chose}} your primary ID in the mobile ID app, then try again. ({{detail}})
addId.already: Added · bringing it in again replaces it
steps: When the mobile ID app opens, agree to share in that app.
Back in KProof, the details you shared are checked.
Only checked details are saved, on this phone. Nothing is kept on a server.
addId.waiting: Waiting for you to share from the mobile ID app…
addId.waitingNote: Come back to KProof after sharing.

scan.title: Scan QR code
scan.hint:
Fit the proof request QR code
shown by the service inside the frame
scan.deniedBody: To scan a proof request QR code, allow camera access for KProof in Settings.
scan.restrictedTitle: The camera can't be used on this phone
scan.restrictedBody: Camera use is blocked by device management settings. You can still receive requests through a "Prove with KProof" button or link on a service.
scan.noCameraBody: This phone has no rear camera the app can use. You can still receive requests through a "Prove with KProof" button or link on a service.
scan.failedBody: If another app is using the camera, close it and try again.

history.title: History
history.intro: When, where and what you proved is recorded on this phone only.

settings.title: Settings
settings.always: Always on. Can't be turned off.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: The ID details saved on this phone will be erased. To use them again, bring them in again from the mobile ID app.
settings.languageDescription: Choose the language used throughout the app.
settings.footer: KProof is made by Masse Labs, Inc. It does not imply certification by or affiliation with any government agency.

E1001.title: Couldn't read the request
E1001.body: The proof request link is invalid. Start again from the service that asked.

E1002.title: Unsupported proof
E1002.body: The service asked for a kind of proof KProof can't create.

E1003.title: The request has expired
E1003.body: The service is no longer waiting. Ask the service to send a new request.

E1004.title: Unverified request
E1004.body: This request didn't come through the KProof relay, so it was not answered.

E1005.title: Invalid request
E1005.body: A value in the request doesn't follow the rules.

E1006.title: The request is too large
E1006.body: The proof request link is larger than allowed.

E1007.title: Already answered
E1007.body: This request has already been answered. To try again, ask the service for a new request.

E1008.title: Not a KProof proof request QR code
E1008.body: Point the camera at the proof request QR code shown by the service.

E2001.title: No ID
E2001.body: Add the ID needed for this proof first.

E2002.title: Can't prove this
E2002.body: The details on this ID can't prove what was asked.

E2003.title: Couldn't prepare the proof circuit
E2003.body: The circuit files couldn't be downloaded, or they don't match the expected files. Check your connection and try again.

E2004.title: Couldn't create the proof
E2004.body: Computing the proof on this phone failed.

E3001.title: Can't reach the server
E3001.body: Check your connection. Your answer did not reach the service.

E3002.title: The server didn't accept the answer
E3002.body: The relay server refused this answer.

E3003.title: Server problem
E3003.body: The relay server returned an error. Your answer may not have reached the service.

E4001.title: Identity not confirmed
E4001.body: The biometric or passcode check was canceled or failed.

E4002.title: Device lock required
E4002.body: KProof protects your ID with biometrics or your device passcode. Turn on Face ID, fingerprint or a passcode in your phone's settings, then open the app again.

E4003.title: Can't read your saved ID
E4003.body: Your biometrics changed or the saved data is damaged. Bring in your ID again.

E5001.title: Couldn't save
E5001.body: Your ID couldn't be saved on this phone.

E5002.title: Couldn't save the language setting
E5002.body: The language you chose is in use now, but the app may return to your phone's language the next time it opens.

E6001.title: Didn't receive your mobile ID
E6001.body: No details arrived from the mobile ID app. Please try again.

E6002.title: Time ran out
E6002.body: Sharing from the mobile ID app wasn't confirmed. Please try again.

E6004.title: Can't open the mobile ID app
E6004.body: Check that the mobile ID app is installed on this phone.

E6005.title: Unsupported ID
E6005.body: KProof doesn't recognize this type of ID.

E6006.title: ID details are incomplete
E6006.body: The details received are missing required items or are in the wrong format. Nothing was saved.

E6007.title: A different ID arrived
E6007.body: Nothing was saved. In the mobile ID app, make the ID you chose your primary ID, then try again. 'Details' shows which ID arrived.

E6008.title: This ID can't be brought in right now
E6008.body: The mobile ID request wasn't accepted. Please try again in a moment.
